title: Origin story: Cu Chulainn
description: Cu Chulainn, born Setanta, earned his name by slaying the smith Culann's hound and taking its place as guard. Trained by the warrior-woman Scathach, he single-handedly held the ford against the armies of Connacht in the Tain, his warp-spasm transforming him into an unrecognizable engine of slaughter.
